sentences.text:
OFFICE NO. NOTE  27-07-15 VVA,J  W.P.No.23104 of 2015  Prima facie, the relief of deletion of petitioners'
 names from the revenue records cannot be  considered, as the Land Acquisition Officer has  already referred the award to the Civil Court under Section 30 of the Land Acquisition Act.
Learned counsel for the petitioners states that  the petitioners have sold the land to the 6th  respondent and they have no objection to receive compensation by the 6th respondent.
The petitioners can as well make such a request before the Civil Court where the said reference is pending.
However, the petitioners' counsel is not aware of the proceedings under the aforesaid reference.
Learned counsel for the petitioners is permitted to take out personal notice to the 6th respondent and file proof of service.

So far as the petitioner's relief against deletion of the land admeasuring Ac.1-00 cents in Sy.No.22/5 from the revenue records is concerned, the petitioners have to approach appropriate authority for rectification of entries in the revenue records.
Hence, no direction as prayed for in that respect can be issued by this Court.
_ __  27-07-2015  Prv  SL. DATE ORDER OFFICE NO.
